subject: Re: Kickoff: mFACE factuality scoring for multilingual summaries
body:
Hi Priya,

Staffing plan: Maren Zhou 50% on the Evalline ingestion and schema work, Amara Okafor 40% on reproducing the NLI scorer, Farah Haddad 30% on the per-language calibration dashboards. Milan Zapata is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 to build the scorer-serving path and the batch API — I've already blocked his June on our side, so please don't let anyone else grab him.

Compute is light: the NLI scorer fine-tunes fit on 16 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort, no reservation needed. Main platform dependency is Evalline; Tomas's team owns the harness and I'd like the schema review on their calendar before March 6.

One flag: the judgement data has three raters per example (hence min/avg/max), and inter-rater spread on q2 is wide for the lower-resource languages. Calibration there will take longer than the roadmap implies.

Santiago
